summary: Courses / 课程 UX/UI reconstruction from Owner Production screenshot. V2.47.160 restores the Learning Center contract after shared mature CSS had visually overridden it: compact factual header/stats rail, lightweight category context, Continue Learning first in one focused compact row, and a two-column learning index with real book covers instead of a boxed card wall. Repetitive synthetic card descriptions are removed when no real description exists. course-library.css is the terminal Courses body owner after shared mature/shell layers; Navigation / Shared Shell appearance is unchanged. Canonical books storage, course state/local completion semantics, frozen Channels/Watch/Topics, schema/data/auth/security/provider/updater mechanisms are unchanged. The first Formal Release attempt was correctly blocked because the newly added contract test used interpolating PHP string literals; that test-only harness defect is corrected in this exact source without changing the product UI candidate. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies from the current continuous UI closure authorization; OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME remains POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED and OWNER_REAL_USE remains POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED. Production remains Owner manual.
